This '''male''' worked as a [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Nerf herder/Legends|herder]] on a remote [[Unidentified fenti bean colony|agricultural colony]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he disappeared near a [[Unidentified ravine|ravine]] that was supposedly haunted. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shalavaa]] was sent to investigate, and although he found one of the herdsman's [[Boot/Legends|boots]], he found no other trace of the man.
